articles.제목: IAEA sees commitment to safety at Kansai's Mihama unit 3
articles.원문 요약: An International Atomic Energy Agency team of experts has completed a review of long-term operational safety of unit 3 of Kansai Electric Power Company's Mihama nuclear power plant in Japan, which reviewed the plant's response to recommendations and suggestions made during a mission in 2024.
